mapper.select: SELECT item.id AS ticket_id, item.order_id, orders.order_no, orders.status AS order_status, orders.user_id, item.status AS ticket_status, passenger.name AS passenger_name, train.train_no, from_station.name AS from_station_name, to_station.name AS to_station_name, item.from_seq, item.to_seq, item.price, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time FROM order_item item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = item.passenger_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train ON train.id = run.train_id JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq WHERE item.id = #{ticketId} AND orders.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_return.id AS return_id, ticket_return.return_no, ticket_return.order_id, orders.order_no, ticket_return.order_item_id AS ticket_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, train.train_no, from_station.name AS from_station_name, to_station.name AS to_station_name, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, ticket_return.ticket_amount, ticket_return.fee_rate, ticket_return.fee_amount, ticket_return.refund_amount, ticket_return.status AS return_status, refund.id AS refund_id, refund.refund_no, refund.status AS refund_status, refund.refunded_at, ticket_return.created_at FROM ticket_return JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = ticket_return.order_id JOIN order_item item ON item.id = ticket_return.order_item_id JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = item.passenger_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train ON train.id = run.train_id JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq LEFT JOIN refund_record refund ON refund.return_id = ticket_return.id WHERE ticket_return.id = #{returnId} AND ticket_return.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
